body: Everything is **compiled**: there is no hand-written Apps Script. `sheet-kit compile` builds the project from a manifest and includes **only the primitives that manifest uses**.
Each feature (gradients, charts, freeze panes and so on) is **one module** with its manifest field, its validation and its render behaviour, so adding one touches nothing else.
Covers the whole Sheets layer: **validation**, **compile**, **deploy** (with clasp), **publish** through a webhook, and **inspect** for reading cells, formulas and formats back.
Plain **Node** JavaScript with JSDoc types and no build step.
